title: AEF 1.0: one line of overlays/events.ndjson
description: Everything after a run closed: a human decision, an adjudication, an annotation, a waiver. Appended, never edited; the run's own sealed files never change.

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this line follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

eventId.description: The event's id, unique in the events file: ov_ and then 1-64 letters or digits (OVL-1).

kind.description: What the event does: approve or reject sets a review status; override or adjudicate sets a result's effective state; waive waives until expires; redact withholds a blob; acknowledge, accept_baseline and annotate are recorded with no effect (OVL-1).

target.description: What the event is about, always inside its own run (spec 04, OVL-2).

result.description: The result the event is about; it must be a result of the run (OVL-2).

requirement.description: The requirement the event is about, by its external id (OVL-1).

blob.description: For redact: the SHA-256 of the blob withheld.

state.description: The state an override or adjudication sets on its result.

reason.description: Why. Required for override, adjudicate, waive and redact (OVL-1).

expires.description: When a waiver ends. Required for waive (OVL-9).

by.description: Who wrote the event, and the assurance the writer claims (OVL-1, OVL-3).

at.description: When the event was written. Shown, never used to reorder events (OVL-1, OVL-6).

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19).

allOf.description: A waiver always says why and until when.
An override or adjudication names the result, the state it sets, and why.

kind.description: Applies to an override or an adjudication (OVL-1).

allOf.description: A redaction names the blob and says why.
